title: solanum dulcamara subvar. villosissimum
intro: Solanum dulcamara subvar. villosissimum, commonly known as the hairy or woody nightshade, is a type of plant that belongs to the Solanaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include treating fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues, as well as its potential to reduce blood sugar levels. The therapeutic actions of Solanum dulcamara subvar. villosissimum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antihistamine properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the effects of this plant on human health, but it has been traditionally used to treat various ailments due to its medicinal properties.
